nodes.label: Custom Voxel Engine
nodes.rationale: A high-performance, deterministic custom voxel engine built natively for the browser using WebGL, WebWorkers, WebRTC, React Three Fiber, Rapier, Zustand, and IndexedDB.

nodes.label: Hybrid Server Tick Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decouples the core game logic (running at 20Hz Fixed Tick / Accumulator) from the visual rendering (up to 144Hz) to guarantee determinism, prevent network desyncs, and avoid death spiral CPU lock-ups by dropping missed ticks.

nodes.label: Voxel Pipeline & Greedy Meshing
nodes.rationale: Terrain chunks are generated off the main thread in a WebWorker pool. Geometry is extracted via Greedy Meshing and baked with ambient occlusion and custom lighting.

nodes.label: P2P Host-Authoritative Networking
nodes.rationale: Multiplayer is serverless, with the browser host acting as the server over WebRTC (PeerJS), propagating chunk differences and validating combat raycasts.

nodes.label: Zero Object Allocation Loop Rule
nodes.rationale: Never instantiate new JavaScript objects or arrays inside rendering/chunk generation loops; reuse existing typed arrays (Float32Array, Uint32Array) to avoid garbage collection pauses.

nodes.label: 32-Bit ECS Block Packing
nodes.rationale: Contiguous Uint32Array(81920) packs texture ID, health, fluid level, isHidden, block light, and sunlight. Reuses objects to avoid overhead.

nodes.label: Off-Thread Chunk Meshing
nodes.rationale: Offload procedural generation and Greedy/Naive meshing to Web Workers (chunkWorker.js) to avoid blocking the main UI thread.

nodes.label: Host Supreme Authority Rule
nodes.rationale: Host executes all physical block breaking, AI, and terrain generation. Guests only send movement intents and interaction requests validated by Host anti-cheat.

nodes.label: Diagnostics & SpectorModal
nodes.rationale: SpectorModal.jsx provides debugging for rendering loops, worker queues, and WebGL memory leaks.

nodes.label: Rule 1: Never Put High-Volume Geometry in React Tree
nodes.rationale: Virtual DOM diffing of InstancedMesh and BufferGeometry on the main thread causes massive 30ms+ frame drops. Must use a native Three.js pipeline (ChunkRenderer.jsx) driven imperatively via useFrame.
nodes.norm_label: rule 1: never put high-volume geometry in react tree

nodes.label: Rule 2: Off-Thread All Terrain & RLE Math
nodes.rationale: Iterating over binary chunks and doing RLE decompression on the main thread pauses the browser. Offload heavy math and DB operations to dbWorker.js.
nodes.norm_label: rule 2: off-thread all terrain & rle math

nodes.label: Rule 3: Zero-Copy Transferable Objects
nodes.rationale: Transfer raw geometry arrays (Uint32Array, Float32Array) via Transferable Objects in postMessage to avoid copy allocation spikes and detached buffer errors.

nodes.label: Rule 4: React is for Hitboxes, Native is for Visuals
nodes.rationale: ChunkPhysics.jsx mounts invisible TrimeshColliders in Rapier. Keep visuals separate from physics. Rapier compiles WebAssembly optimizations.
nodes.norm_label: rule 4: react is for hitboxes, native is for visuals

nodes.label: Host-Authoritative Combat System
nodes.rationale: Evaluates weapon logic on the Host in a 20Hz Fixed Physics Tick, ensuring hitscans (raycasts) and projectiles strike exactly where enemies are physically located.

nodes.label: Hitscan and Melee Logic
nodes.rationale: Gauss rifle uses world.castRay. Melee weapons use front-facing cleave AoE sweeps to easily strike small entities like Muck Pigs.

nodes.label: Projectile Physics & Syncing
nodes.rationale: Spawns Rapier RigidBody projectiles. Broadcasts SPAWN_PROJECTILE for visual tracer rendering. Projectiles are GC-ed after 5 seconds.

nodes.label: Centralized Swarm Manager
nodes.rationale: Processes AI pathfinding and target acquisition on the Host. Spawns mobs adaptively over procedural valleys/hills.

nodes.label: Grapple Gun Tethering
nodes.rationale: Tether.jsx renders dynamic instanced cylinders stretching from the player barrel to anchor, while the physics controller applies forces.

nodes.label: Admin Commands Authority
nodes.rationale: Exclusive to the Host. Evaluates command intents inside useNetworkStore.js handleCommandIntent after verifying player ID.

nodes.label: Kick Command
nodes.rationale: Closes target's PeerJS WebRTC connection and broadcasts a system message.

nodes.label: Time Set Command
nodes.rationale: Modifies worldTime in createWorldSlice, updating sun/moon positions in DynamicSky.jsx.

nodes.label: Give Command
nodes.rationale: Spawns items into the inventory or drops them; updates local inventory or sends network event to guest PlayerSlice.

nodes.label: Teleport Command
nodes.rationale: Overrides target player position in Rapier, temporarily disabling anti-cheat rubber-banding for that tick.

nodes.label: Game Modes System
nodes.rationale: Survival (crafting, health, Tombstone generation), Creative (unlimited inventory, invincibility, double-jump flight, un-clamped vertical falls), and Hardcore (permanent death penalties) modes.

nodes.label: God Nodes Bottlenecks
nodes.rationale: useStore (77 edges) and getIndex() (22 edges) are the central architectural bottlenecks. Custom slices should be preferred.

nodes.label: Audio-Store-Player Import Cycle
nodes.rationale: GameAudio.js -> useStore.js -> createPlayerSlice.js -> GameAudio.js. Dangerous circular dependency.

nodes.label: Isolated Code Technical Debt
nodes.rationale: 271 isolated nodes with <= 1 edge suggest dead code, package.json parameters, or disconnected features that should be deleted.

nodes.label: Monolithic useStore Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Monolithic useStore has been split into isolated Zustand stores (useChunkStore, useInventoryStore, useFlareStore) to prevent re-rendering and save memory.

nodes.label: Strangler Fig Interceptors
nodes.rationale: worldActions.js uses proxy interceptors inside setState to forward legacy patch.droppedItems and patch.chunks updates to decoupled stores without breaking legacy code.

nodes.label: Custom AABB Frustum Culling
nodes.rationale: Disables native Three.js sphere culling (which fails for 320-block tall chunks) and evaluates custom Box3 intersection against globalFrustum in useFrame.

nodes.label: Zustand Decoupling Bug Fixes
nodes.rationale: Fixed legacy droppedItems zombie state desync, silent block failures (fixed worldActions reading new chunks via legacy bindings), and far-away chunk memory leaks (fixed unloadChunk undefined chunks via useChunkStore.getState().chunks).

nodes.label: Physics Accumulator & Tick
nodes.rationale: Game logic runs inside a 30Hz tick loop (timeStep={1/30}). Physics accumulator prevents death spirals by limiting catch-up ticks to 10 per frame.

nodes.label: 144Hz Visual Interpolation
nodes.rationale: Smooths guest player and swarm positions by interpolating visuals using a Snapshot Buffer in useFrame to hide network latency.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Chunk Persistence
nodes.rationale: Prefixes chunk keys by saveSlotId. Saves Uint32Array(81920) buffers compressed via Run-Length Encoding (RLE) to decrease disk I/O.

nodes.label: Web Worker Structured Clone Rules
nodes.rationale: Avoid referencing detached buffers by making copies when neighbor checks are pending. Safely copy Web Worker payloads on the main thread. Avoid using for...in loops for copying typed arrays.

nodes.label: Completed Voxel & Engine Features
nodes.rationale: Summarizes voxel ECS format, imperative InstancedMesh flora, cellular fluid system, absolute Y=-100 kill planes, anti-cheat, logic TPS tracker, and SpectorModal.

nodes.label: Sci-Fi Voxel Visual Language
nodes.rationale: Implements glassmorphism panels (backdrop-blur-md, slate-900/60, border-white/10), sleek dark mode base colors, neon gradients, uppercase technical typography, and spring micro-interactions.

nodes.label: Coding Standards & ECS Principles
nodes.rationale: Covers performance first, data locality, custom WebGL lighting compilation (overriding #include <lights_fragment_begin>), and material sharing anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Zero Object Allocation Loop Principle
nodes.rationale: Within the inner rendering and chunk generation loops, never instantiate new objects or arrays. Reuse existing typed arrays.

nodes.label: 32-Bit ECS Standard Principle
nodes.rationale: All voxel data must strictly adhere to the 32-bit integer schema. Do not create individual JS objects for blocks.

nodes.label: Material Sharing Anti-Pattern Principle
nodes.rationale: Do not share ShaderMaterial between Mesh and InstancedMesh. Three.js relies on compilation macros like #define INSTANCED, which are dropped if shared.

nodes.label: Host Authority Principle
nodes.rationale: The Host is the absolute authority for physical block breaking, entity AI, and generation, verifying guest inputs over WebRTC data channels.

nodes.label: Query: WorkerManager connection explanation
nodes.rationale: WorkerManager coordinates task dispatching to chunkWorker.js Web Workers for off-thread terrain generation, lighting calculations, and greedy meshing. Worker tasks rely on voxel block characteristics defined in blocks.json and exposed via BlockRegistry.js. worldActions.js (Zustand state store) bridges this by evaluating block changes on the main thread and importing workerPool.js to trigger async worker rebuilds.

nodes.label: Query: GameAudioSystem connection explanation
nodes.rationale: GameAudioSystem acts as the Web Audio API engine. It directly imports useStore from the state store to sync playback volume with the player settings. In initialize(), it sets up a Zustand store subscription for sfxVolume, musicVolume, and isMuted. When these setting values change in the UI, updateVolumes() pulls the new values and dynamically adjusts the sfxGain and musicGain buses. It also retrieves settings during triggerDucking() to ramp music volume down and smoothly recover to the user-defined level.

nodes.label: Amanatides-Woo DDA Raycasting
nodes.rationale: Avoids mesh-based raycasting on greedy-meshed geometries by mathematically stepping through the CPU block data grid at O(distance) cost to pick individual 1x1x1 blocks.

nodes.label: Architectural Linter Constraints
nodes.rationale: Enforces three main performance/stability rules: no mapping of massive geometries in React virtual DOM, no main-thread RLE decompression, and no for...in loops on TypedArrays.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Physics Audit
nodes.rationale: Audit that applied fixes for Ship Raycaster Stride, Gimbal Lock, and Stationary Vector Collapse, tracked in version 4 of the canary tracker.

nodes.label: Hybrid Network Tick Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decouples physics simulation (30Hz) from visual rendering (144Hz) to prevent race conditions and synchronize host/guest clients.

nodes.label: Physics Accumulator & Death Spiral Prevention
nodes.rationale: Prevents death spiral browser crashes by limiting physics catch-up calculations to a maximum of 10 ticks per frame.

nodes.label: Visual Interpolation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Smoothes guest and enemy movements using a Snapshot Buffer to mask network latency.

nodes.label: WebGL DataTextures Heightmap
nodes.rationale: Puts occlusion calculations (like weather stopping) into O(1) shader lookups instead of expensive CPU-side raycasts.

nodes.label: ECS Voxel Bitpacking
nodes.rationale: Stores 16x320x16 chunk voxel data in contiguous 32-bit Uint32Arrays to optimize memory and leverage cache locality.

nodes.label: Transferable Objects Constraint
nodes.rationale: Enables zero-copy O(1) memory transfer between Web Workers and the main thread, bypassing slow structured clones.

nodes.label: Glassmorphism & Depth UI Panel Design
nodes.rationale: Uses semi-transparent, backdrop-blurred panels to maintain player immersion and depth in the 3D world.

nodes.label: Sleek Dark Mode Theme
nodes.rationale: Deep indigo, slate gray, and bright neon accents evoke a modern sci-fi feel and prevent blinding screen flashes.

nodes.label: Material Sharing Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: ShaderMaterial cannot be shared between Mesh and InstancedMesh because instancing compilation macros will be dropped, breaking rendering.

nodes.label: Custom Lighting Compilation Shaders
nodes.rationale: Overrides Three.js standard lights with custom ambient occlusion, blocklight, and sunlight shaders to avoid expensive cascaded shadow maps.

nodes.label: Host Authority & Anti-Cheat Validation
nodes.rationale: Ensures all physics modifications, logic updates, and entity AI loops run authoritatively on the Host with WebRTC inputs validated.

nodes.label: No High-Volume Geometry in React Tree
nodes.rationale: React reconciler cannot diff thousands of buffer geometries without dropping frames; mesh lifecycle must be managed natively.
nodes.norm_label: no high-volume geometry in react tree

nodes.label: Off-Thread Voxel Terrain and RLE Math
nodes.rationale: Offloads all heavy terrain generation, meshing, and database operations to Web Workers to keep the main thread at 60 FPS.

nodes.label: Canary Tracker Protocol
nodes.rationale: Enforces a version increment check in CI/CD tests on any core engine/state modifications to prevent AI context drift and regressions.

nodes.label: Ship Raycaster Vector Stride
nodes.rationale: Uses Y * 1024 + Z * 32 + X stride to ensure raycasts properly align with the ship's 1D Uint32Array memory representation.

nodes.label: Decoupling of the Monolithic God Object
nodes.rationale: Splits useStore into specialized Zustand slices (useChunkStore, etc.) to minimize unnecessary component re-renders.

nodes.label: Custom AABB Frustum Culling
nodes.rationale: Three.js spherical culling fails for tall (320 blocks) voxel chunks; evaluated custom Box3 intersection against frustum in useFrame.

nodes.label: Static Compression Buffers
nodes.rationale: Uses a thread-local static RLE_TEMP_BUFFER inside dbWorker.js to avoid allocating memory during chunk saving.

nodes.label: Host-Authoritative Combat System
nodes.rationale: Host validates all weapon fires, hitscan sweeps, and projectile impacts to prevent client-side hacking.

nodes.label: Grapple Gun Physics Tether
nodes.rationale: Calculates anchor point via raycast and applies continuous physical pulling force, rendered using an instanced cylinder.

nodes.label: Hybrid Flight System
nodes.rationale: Converts the static Warp Ship into a drivable voxel vehicle utilizing Rapier kinematic RigidBodies.

nodes.label: Captain vs Passenger Seating System
nodes.rationale: Differentiates helm driving seats from passenger seats, using Amanatides-Woo DDA checks to snap players to correct offset/rotation.

nodes.label: O(1) Hardware Tracking Optimization
nodes.rationale: Tracks engine/capacitor block counts incrementally during placing/breaking instead of O(N) loops over 32,768 voxel blocks.

nodes.label: Warp Drive and Glitch Minigame
nodes.rationale: Enables long-distance travel by climbing to the warp void, triggering host-side glitch storms and requiring repairs in transit.
